changes_from_what_was_registered: N8j.v2: raw capture and desktop blur, his decision

No record is written to my store at import, because a store record enters the local replication log; the capture is files under the data root only, and I remember it through this conversation's own records
Frames are read only through the video element; MediaStreamTrackProcessor and ImageCapture were not tried
The room's wasm grew from 8.10 to about 8.3 MB
limitations: no headset was used: frame rate, how many pictures a walk yields, memory on the Quest for a long capture, alignment and how the textures look are unknown until his walk
the desktop blur uses the same model family at 640x480 and 320x240; it is more thorough than the browser's, not a different kind of detector
textures can paint through furniture; depth is not captured
dhilipsiva.dev does not carry face-worker.js, so opening a raw file there is refused; github.io carries it

class: C then A: dhilipsiva's report from his Meta Quest 3, then a headless regression

report.his_words: The images seems to be missing from the export

reading: The first live build (0b2f771) kept no pictures on his headset. I have not seen his file, so the cause is inferred, not observed: pictures were encoded with canvas.toBlob, which answers from the browser's idle time, and a page behind an immersive session may get none. My headless run never hid the page and could not catch it.
change: Pictures are now encoded at once with canvas.toDataURL; each lost frame is counted with its reason and written into the file's notes; the board shows pictures kept of frames delivered.
check: room/test/home.mjs now starves canvas.toBlob for as long as the shimmed session runs: 114 of 114 frames kept, and the capture never called it. Orchestration only.
open: Whether this was the cause on his headset is unknown until he captures again; if pictures are still missing, the file's notes will say why.

report.source: his Meta Quest 3, OculusBrowser 156, build 16d1318; the file reached this desktop and was read for counts; one picture was looked at

reading: The picture fix of 16d1318 held on his headset: every frame the camera delivered was kept. The geometry is his home. The pictures are not: they are one soft pastel picture with pink bubbles, nearly byte-identical 57 times, from the only camera the page was given ('camera 0, facing front'). The headset gave my page a stand-in, not its passthrough cameras.
also: He first exported the conversation ('Export all') and found no pictures in it; the capture is a separate file. Fixed in 1d005d9: the button is 'Export conversation' and the capture is offered beside it. The file's note 'the camera never started' was wrong: it was written after the camera was stopped.
change: roadmap/N8j.v3.md: the capture looks for a world-facing camera, names the camera it used, and says when its pictures all look the same; the wrong note is fixed.
check: room/test/home.mjs asserts the camera is named in the notes and not noted absent; garage/camera.rs has native tests on his headset's label and his pictures' sizes. Orchestration only.
open: Whether his Quest offers a web page any camera that sees the room. Not imported into my store: the pictures hold nothing of his home.
